description: Foundry development checks shared with Claude; plugin runtime hooks remain separate.

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');let dir=process.cwd();for(;;){const file=path.join(dir,'.claude','hooks','run-tests-on-edit.js');if(fs.existsSync(file)){const hook=require(file);if(hook.main)hook.main();break;}const parent=path.dirname(dir);if(parent===dir)throw Error('Foundry hook root not found');dir=parent;}"
